traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
The demon has advantage on saving throws against
spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text: The demon’s weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The demon’s spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 10, +2 to hit with spell attacks). The demon can innately cast the following spells at will, requiring no material components: darkness, detect evil and good, invisibility (self only)

traits.name: Slimy Hide
traits.text:
The demon’s hide is extremely slick and oozes with slime.
Creatures attempting to grapple the demon do so with disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The demon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two
with its claws. It can use its Spit Slime in place of the bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target.
Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spit Slime
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft.,
one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) acid damage and the target must succeed
on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or its speed is reduced by half
until the end of the demon’s next turn.
